verdicts.statement: The index rate alert feature is disabled by default.

verdicts.statement: Alert messages include the 20 sources and applications with the largest index-rate growth during the past 2 hours.

verdicts.statement: Notifications continue until the index rate falls below the configured thresholds.

verdicts.statement: The days for sending index rate alerts can be configured.

verdicts.statement: The hours for sending index rate alerts can be configured.
